title: Nudi in Molokhia and Vine Leaf Broth
subtitle: ricotta dumplings with brown butter and parmesan
description: Tender ricotta and semolina dumplings pan-fried in butter and served in a broth of molokhia and fresh vine leaves, a meeting of Arab and Italian kitchens.

steps.text: Mix all the nudi ingredients (ricotta, semolina, egg yolk, parmesan, 1/2 teaspoon salt and the pepper) in a bowl until uniform. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
With slightly wet hands, roll the mixture into cherry-sized balls, roll in a shallow bowl of durum flour until fully coated, arrange on a floured tray and refrigerate for another 12 hours.

Heat the olive oil in a pot over high heat, add the chopped molokhia and vine leaves and fry for about 4 minutes, stirring, until nicely golden. Push the leaves to the side, add the thinly sliced onion and fry for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the water and 1 teaspoon salt, stir, bring to the boil and cook over medium heat, uncovered, for about 25 minutes until the liquid reduces.
Heat the butter in a pan and pan-fry the nudi for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Transfer the nudi to the broth, sprinkle over grated parmesan and serve.
